mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 500 thousand and retail sales above 370 billion dollars indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 370000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 (index 2017=100) indicates economic contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation below 1.5% annualized indicates stable price conditions that protect corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation < 1.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% signals economic stagnation that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ growth < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 200 thousand per month indicates accelerating labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate hiring, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 200k, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production below 95 and real GDP below 13,300 billion dollars indicate dual contraction in supply and demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95 and GDPC1 < 13300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
